description: Leak-test denylist. Core ships the method, never the author's own program. A match in the shipped tree fails CI. Patterns are JS regex source, matched case-insensitively unless noted. Extend per release; this is the single home (drift canary).

licensed_text_guard.note: A PHYSICAL-PATH guard, not a content grep: no file may be committed under these dirs. Doctrine is free to name the path in prose.

note: docs/ is excluded from the scan on purpose: it carries the plan and provenance, where the author's platform is named as context. Shipped STEERING, SCHEMAS, AGENTS, STAGES and CODE must be clean.
